segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: A Cayman Islands blank check company formed to effect a merger or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities.
segments.evidence: The Company was incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities.

changes.text: In 2025, shareholders approved changing the company's name from Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. I to Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. IV, with the company to be renamed Merlin, Inc. upon the proposed business combination.
changes.evidence: On October 21, 2025, our shareholders approved (i) a proposal to change the name of the name of the Company from "Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. I" to "Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. IV"
